proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6648 dva explicitly gives eastern dui and Western Pahari dūī two. The selected dui̯/dui ̯/du.i and Kullui dʊːi/dʊwi/ˈdʊwi retain source syllabicity, vowel length, glide and stress notation. These are bare numerals without classifier material; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: dʊːi.
